```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(emoji)

emoji_out <- emoji_glue(":broom::fowl:")
```

## `r emoji_out`: Note on "filthy fowl" project name

Because project titles change all the time we used
[{codename}](http://svmiller.com/codename/) to generate an generate an
[Ubuntu-style](https://wiki.ubuntu.com/DevelopmentCodeNames) internal-to-us
project name that won’t change.

```{r codename, eval=FALSE}
library(codename)

codename_message()
#> code name generated by {codename} v.0.5.0. R version 4.4.2 (2024-10-31 ucrt).

codename(seed = "future self-continuity", type = "ubuntu")
#> "filthy fowl"
```
